faq.q: Is it really a one-time payment?
faq.a: Yes. You pay once and get every future update. No subscription, no renewal fee. Prices may go up as sldev-io grows, but never for licenses you already own.
Nothing. sldev-io is free while it is in beta. When paid licenses launch, the prices on this page are the ones you will see.

faq.q: Do I need an account with every agent?
faq.a: sldev-io drives the agent CLIs that are already on your machine and uses their own logins. It never replaces your Claude, OpenAI, Cursor or GitHub subscription.

faq.q: How many machines can I use?
faq.a: A Personal license covers one developer on up to 3 machines. When you replace a machine, you can move the license to the new one.
Yes. If sldev-io isn't for you, ask within 14 days of buying for a full refund. See the refund policy.
No. There is no account, no telemetry and no analytics. Your code, terminals, notes and credentials stay on your machine. The privacy policy lists the few network requests the app makes.
